verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Database Webhooks that fire automatically on INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE table events. They are built as triggers using pg_net and deliver HTTP payloads to any endpoint, explicitly including Edge Functions, which the docs say can listen to webhooks. That covers the database-event half of the story directly. Nothing in the pack shows functions being triggered by auth events. Missing for 10: documented auth-event triggers or hooks (e.g. on sign-up or login), richer docs on payload and retry semantics for invoking Edge Functions from table events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run functions automatically in response to database or auth events

citations.quote: Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.
with payloads delivered as HTTP requests to any endpoint (including Edge Functions)
They can be used for listening to webhooks
